# garage_admin_token (Data Source)

Look up a Garage admin token by ID or get the current token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get current token info
data "garage_admin_token" "current" {
  current = true
}

# Look up by ID
data "garage_admin_token" "deploy" {
  id = "abc123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `current` (Boolean) Set to true to get info about the current token being used.
- `id` (String) Admin token ID. Exactly one of `id` or `current` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `expiration` (String) Expiration date.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether expired.
- `name` (String) Token name.
- `scope` (List of String) Token scope.
